one_line: Brahmin student of Kanchi who became the founding warrior-king of the Kadamba dynasty in the western Deccan.

appearance.age_look: Mid-20s, lean but well-trained build, height slightly above average, with the wiry strength of a forest-hardened warrior-scholar.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, sharp jawline and medium-brown Deccan complexion; dark, intense eyes with thick brows, a small sandalwood tilak on the forehead, and a calm but determined default expression that hints at contained anger and resolve.
appearance.hair: Long, dark brown-black hair drawn into a high, neatly wound Brahmin-style topknot (śikhā) at the back-crown, with a few controlled loose strands at the temples; no helmet, but a narrow, plain gold headband encircling the forehead and tying behind the topknot.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate 4th-century Deccan Brahmin-warrior attire: an unstitched, ankle-length off-white dhoti wrapped cleanly and tightly with a broad double border in deep maroon along the hem, pleated in front for ease of movement; an upper body wrapped in a short-sleeved, close-fitting, light cotton angavastra-style tunic in muted pale yellow that stays modestly over the torso, with an additional maroon-bordered cream uttariya (shawl) draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the right forearm; a sacred thread (yajnopavita) visible diagonally under the shawl; simple leather belt at the waist holding a scabbard; feet in brown leather sandals appropriate for forest and battlefield; minimal jewellery—small round gold earrings, a single thin gold armlet on the right bicep, and a rudraksha bead necklace to recall his ascetic-learning past.
appearance.signature: A straight-edged, early Deccan iron sword with a slightly broad leaf-shaped blade, simple crossguard, and unornamented wooden hilt wrapped in dark leather, worn at his left hip in a plain brown scabbard and often held in his right hand as if just drawn.

ref_desc: Mayurasharma appears as a lean, medium-brown young man with an oval face, dark intense eyes, a sandalwood tilak, long dark hair in a Brahmin topknot with a thin gold headband, wearing an off-white dhoti with deep maroon border, pale yellow tunic, cream maroon-bordered shawl, simple sandals, sacred thread and minimal gold-rudraksha jewellery, carrying a plain iron sword with leather-wrapped hilt in a brown scabbard, all dominated by off-white, deep maroon, pale yellow, brown leather and gold colours.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Mayurasharma, the founding Kadamba king, as a dignified 4th-century Deccan Brahmin-turned-warrior: a lean, slightly tall young man with medium-brown skin, an oval face, sharp jawline, straight nose, dark intense eyes and thick brows, bearing a small sandalwood tilak and a calm but resolute expression. His long dark brown-black hair is gathered into a neat Brahmin topknot (śikhā) at the back-crown, with a few short strands at the temples, and a thin plain gold headband encircles his forehead and tying behind the knot. He wears an era-accurate, fully modest outfit: a tightly wrapped, ankle-length off-white dhoti with a broad deep maroon border, carefully pleated at the front; a close-fitting, short-sleeved pale yellow cotton tunic covering his torso; and a cream uttariya shawl with maroon border draped from his left shoulder diagonally across his chest and looping around his right forearm. A sacred thread runs diagonally beneath the shawl, and a simple leather belt at his waist holds a plain brown scabbard. His feet are in sturdy brown leather sandals suited for forest travel. Add small round gold earrings, a thin gold armlet on his right bicep, and a single rudraksha bead necklace for subtle spiritual gravitas, avoiding any heavy royal crowns or fantasy armour. His signature weapon is a realistic early Deccan straight iron sword with a slightly broad leaf-shaped blade and a simple crossguard, its wooden hilt wrapped in dark leather, worn at his left hip and shown in hand in at least one pose. Use a restrained palette dominated by off-white, deep maroon, pale yellow, brown leather and gold, and present him from multiple angles and poses while keeping the same face, hair, clothing and sword design consistent.
